link.$description: Link component tokens. Font size and weight are inherited from the surrounding text, so links add no type styles. Evidence: audit family F01 (3,295 instances, 21 variants, 44 designs; link text in 4 blues, one failing AA).

thickness-hover.$description: PROPOSED: 2px underline on hover for always-underlined links, so hover is visible without a colour change.

offset.$description: PROPOSED: gap between text and underline, clear of descenders.

inverse-color.$description: PROPOSED: white ring on dark surfaces (blue is 1.87:1 on navy).

radius.$description: PROPOSED: softens the ring's corners around text.

default.$description: OBSERVED: blue #0559b3 (1,007 el / 11 exp), the one link blue. Absorbs #0888ba (fails AA), #0c6cc4, #0056b6. Only 2.50:1 against ink body text, below the 3:1 needed to mark a link by colour alone, so inline links are always underlined (decision 22).
OBSERVED: near-black bold links (listing titles, navigation), the most common link look. Absorbs #000000 and #212529 (decision 22).
OBSERVED: white links on dark surfaces (16 and 18px).
